name: Unizen Trade Aggregator arbitrary call in swap

classification.summary: A newly upgraded swap entrypoint on the Unizen Trade Aggregator proxy executed an attacker-supplied (target, calldata) Call without whitelisting the target, so transferFrom calls were forwarded to arbitrary ERC-20s and drained every wallet that still had an allowance to the aggregator.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

lastCodeChange.description: Legacy basis: latest of 10 pre-incident Upgraded event(s).

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/unizen.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: proxy 0xd3f64BAa732061F8B3626ee44bab354f854877AC created 2022-09-27 by 0xdbc320a510bcf1a8368ca38fc3ad773e259ced26, not the attacker; ten EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last at block 19391308 on 2024-03-08T15:21:35Z installing implementation 0xa051fc7d38baa0ace811ad9de4e9f7024e5d8a30 — 8.5 hours before the incident — so codeAge is measured from that upgrade, not from the 2022 deployment. src/test/2024-03/UnizenIO2_exp.sol covers a second drain transaction (0xdd0636e2598f4d7b74f364fedb38f334365fd956747a04a6dd597444af0bc1c0) against the same proxy and is not recorded separately.

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/unizen.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The exploit block or transaction index remains unresolved.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
